'''Photonic charges''' were a type of explosive weaponry used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Whiplash]] leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
